why_trail.why: The rework is one blocker plus two prose asks. The guard's _ENGINE_VERBS is a hand-typed 17-verb string while the engine's argparse registers 18; the missing verb is resume, so 'Second path: <cli> resume g1 --reason unblocked' passes all four patterns and that is exactly the class g1b opened to close. CREW_CONTEXT.md's Verification Discipline names this shape directly: define a guard by its consumer's behaviour, not a hand-maintained list. The oracle already exists in-tree at test_mcp_adoption._engine_verbs(), read from argparse's own choices, needing no SPINE_FILE env -- and this file already imports three names from that module, so deriving adds no new import direction. All three interpreters carry pytest 9.1.1 on this host.

The durable fix, not the one-token one: _ENGINE_VERBS is now built from test_mcp_adoption._engine_verbs(), sorted and re.escape'd per verb, so both ENGINE_INVOCATION_RE and ENGINE_STANDIN_COMMAND_RE read the engine's own argparse registry. ENGINE_VERBS recovers the set back OUT of the alternation the compiled patterns are built from, so the tie test still bites if a later author replaces the derivation with a literal. Three tie assertions plus the 18-verb control count, and the blocker line is pinned as a STAND_IN_COMMANDS fixture so the specific miss cannot return even if the derivation is replaced. 15 passed, 4 deselected.

Cost re-measured on this tree rather than inherited: over 3098 texts across 216 files, adding resume moves ENGINE_INVOCATION_RE from 12 to 12 addresses and ENGINE_STANDIN_COMMAND_RE from 23 to 23 -- delta ZERO for both, nothing added and nothing lost, union over all four patterns 36 either way. The counterfactual is the 17-verb list rebuilt from the engine minus resume, so it prices the verb rather than the derivation. Blocker line: MISS under 17 verbs, MATCH under 18. Floors 101/2/113/3098 unchanged against 60/1/60/1800, zero strays under .agent-work/ outside the overlay, both pre-ruled survivors still out of the walk, exclusion mechanism still the directory-plus-suffix rule with no file list of any length.

The code-span argument is now scoped to Markdown and priced: 40 occurrences of a stand-in followed by whitespace and an ordinary English word, across 25 files containing one, 13 distinct sentences mirrored three ways; 27 sit in JSON template imperatives where backticks are not the house habit and 31 of the 40 are not code-spanned at all, so the argument covers a quarter of the population. What holds the false-alarm count at zero is that none of those 40 following words is an engine verb, and nine verbs are common English -- said plainly so a later author does not over-trust the backtick story. Every census is now written as N occurrences across M files containing X, with the 16-in-6-leaves example showing why occurrences, lines and files differ here. The three unswept placeholder dialects are named as accepted residuals with the oracle-vs-judgement reason.

Both closing checks pass: the gate's own POSIX form runs clean through /bin/sh (dash) at exit 0, test_mcp_adoption.py is untouched and green at 183 passed, and the only dirty path across skills specs docs scripts episodes tests map .agent-work/templates is tests/test_cli_retirement_guard.py. The IMPLEMENTER_RESULT is written to the handoff's named path with return status complete, carrying the pre-change miss, the derivation, the four tie assertions, the zero-delta cost measurement, the two reported disagreements with the handoff's own figures, and the accepted g2 coupling.
